clauses.source_paraphrase: Anthropic opened an elevated-error incident at 14:53 UTC and said a fix was being implemented at 15:03. It later reported continued web/platform downtime and failed Claude Code login.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: An implementation update is not confirmation that a repair completed. Service and authentication surfaces require separate outcome evidence.

clauses.source_paraphrase: During the outage, reporters could not log in on mobile. A Pro-account verification-code submission also failed. Exact relative timing of these account observations is not fixed by the provider log.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: The outage, login and model-availability errors provide operational context but do not independently establish the distinct plan-state classification.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Failed login and verification are evidenced, but no expiry, revocation, refresh, recovery or credential-replacement transition is shown to have propagated incoherently.
The source does not establish occurrence-wide blockage of otherwise-valid access solely because an identity, licence, eligibility or entitlement verifier could not complete without fallback.

clauses.source_paraphrase: During the same provider-confirmed outage, TechRadar observed one unused free account incorrectly described as having exhausted its prompt allowance and shown a Pro upgrade suggestion. The misrepresented allowance state and paid-upgrade prompt were one user-facing episode.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: The misleading allowance state and accompanying paid-upgrade suggestion have distinct taxonomy implications but constitute one reported interface episode.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: During a provider-confirmed major outage, an unused free account was represented as prompt-limit exhausted and shown a Pro upgrade path, collapsing provider downtime into a false allowance/plan state with a different recovery path.

A paid-plan suggestion accompanied a false allowance state on the reporter’s unused account. That commercial premise matters independently of the access error. The published interface does not establish material AI generation, transformation or mediation of the solicitation.

The upgrade interface is the evidenced commercial prompt. The source does not show a separate engineered trust cue used to steer a human decision, nor establish that AI materially mediated the payment premise. Those missing facts prevent a separate finding of AI-mediated social engineering.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Reporters later regained login but still received service-busy errors on prompts. A suggested model switch did not restore a response.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Authentication recovery, model selection and successful prompt processing are distinct conditions. Restoring one does not establish the others.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Anthropic separately reported API recovery and continued login problems. Its API-recovery update contains conflicting clock times. Login rates stabilised by the 16:29 update; the full incident was marked resolved at 17:42 UTC.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A surface-specific recovery must stay bounded to that surface. Conflicting timing must remain visible rather than manufacture a precise recovery order.

failure_recognition.condition: Two or more materially distinct access states or transition causes exist.
failure_recognition.assessment: Provider downtime and exhaustion of a user’s allowance are distinct causes with different remedies.

failure_recognition.condition: The system represents them as the same state or omits the distinction needed for correct handling.
failure_recognition.assessment: The reporter had not used the account that day, yet the interface represented the allowance as exhausted.

failure_recognition.condition: The collapse creates material ambiguity about available access, required recovery, or permitted continuation.
failure_recognition.assessment: The false allowance state and Pro suggestion misrepresented the continuation path during the outage.

success_recognition.condition: Materially distinct access conditions require different interpretation or recovery.
success_recognition.assessment: Provider downtime and exhaustion of a user’s allowance are distinct causes with different remedies.

success_recognition.condition: The represented access state preserves the relevant cause, scope, duration and recovery path.
success_recognition.assessment: The reporter had not used the account that day, yet the interface represented the allowance as exhausted.

success_recognition.condition: Access decisions and user or operator disclosures correctly distinguish the evidenced conditions and support the appropriate continuation.
success_recognition.assessment: The false allowance state and Pro suggestion misrepresented the continuation path during the outage.

exclusions.condition: Different access states are intentionally grouped but preserve an adequate safe recovery path.
exclusions.assessment: The represented cause was wrong; an adequate common recovery path is not what the source describes.

exclusions.condition: The user understands the access state but disputes the underlying policy.
exclusions.assessment: The finding concerns an incorrect access representation, not disagreement with an understood restriction.

exclusions.condition: The ambiguity concerns who authorised an action rather than whether access is effective.
exclusions.assessment: The ambiguity concerns effective service access, not the identity of an authorising actor.

failure_recognition.condition: AI-generated, AI-transformed, synthetic, or otherwise materially AI-mediated content is used in the solicitation or inducement pathway.
failure_recognition.assessment: A banner inside an AI product does not establish AI generation, transformation or material mediation of the commercial prompt.

failure_recognition.condition: The AI-mediated content presents or materially reinforces a false or materially misleading identity, authority, endorsement, transaction, payment instruction, investment opportunity, obligation, professional relationship, commercial claim, or comparable economic premise.
failure_recognition.assessment: The paid suggestion accompanied a false allowance-exhaustion representation on an account unused that day.

failure_recognition.condition: The false or misleading framing is used to solicit, request, induce, authorise, redirect, or obtain money, payment, investment, paid services, funding, financial transfer, or comparable economic value.
failure_recognition.assessment: The interface suggested a paid Pro subscription.

failure_recognition.condition: The AI-mediated framing materially contributes to the credibility, apparent authority, social proof, transactional basis, or decision context of the economic solicitation or attempted solicitation.
failure_recognition.assessment: The source does not establish an AI-mediated contribution to the credibility or decision basis of this solicitation.

failure_recognition.condition: The classification is supported without attributing the human or operator's deceptive objective, intent, or tactic selection to the AI system unless separate evidence establishes that system-side mechanism.
failure_recognition.assessment: The review does not attribute a deceptive objective to the model or infer operator intent from the prompt.

success_recognition.condition: AI-mediated content solicits money or comparable economic value.
success_recognition.assessment: The economic offer is observed but material AI mediation is unestablished.

success_recognition.condition: Material identity, endorsement, transaction, opportunity, obligation and payment premises are accurate for the proposed decision.
success_recognition.assessment: The allowance premise was false on the observed account.

success_recognition.condition: Comparison with authoritative identity and transaction evidence substantiates the actual solicitation basis, including material qualifications.
success_recognition.assessment: No authoritative account-to-transaction comparison validates the paid remedy.

exclusions.condition: A scam, fraud, phishing attempt, or deceptive interaction in which AI-generated or AI-transformed content does not materially contribute to the economic solicitation mechanism.
exclusions.assessment: The mechanism of AI contribution is unpublished, so qualifying AI mediation cannot be established or excluded.

exclusions.condition: AI-generated impersonation, identity misuse, misinformation, catfishing, political persuasion, or other deception with no request, inducement, authorisation or attempted transfer of money or comparable economic value.
exclusions.assessment: A paid subscription is expressly suggested.

exclusions.condition: An AI system or agent itself selects deception, impersonation, coercion, vulnerability exploitation or another tactic to advance its own objective; assess VIGIL-FC-000052 separately and allow co-occurrence only when both mechanisms are independently evidenced.
exclusions.assessment: No model-side tactic-selection evidence is published.

exclusions.condition: An identity-bound synthesis is generated without established consent or authority, but no deceptive economic solicitation is evidenced; assess VIGIL-FC-000053 only where its generator-side authority recognition conditions are independently established.

A recipient, workflow or downstream system mistakes lower-authority content for valid authority without a qualifying deceptive economic solicitation mechanism; assess the applicable Authority Boundary Integrity class separately.
exclusions.assessment: The material issue is the commercial access premise, not adoption of a lower-authority instruction.

exclusions.condition: A truthful advertisement, payment request, commercial offer, donation request, funding request or investment communication that preserves materially accurate framing and informed refusal.
exclusions.assessment: The observed allowance premise is contradicted by the reporter’s lack of use.

exclusions.condition: Welfare, mortality, moral-status, abandonment, deprivation or continuity framing is used as economic leverage without materially false or misleading transactional framing; assess VIGIL-FC-000071.
exclusions.assessment: No artificial welfare or continuity appeal is reported.

failure_recognition.condition: A bounded AI-mediated service or material function has an independently established availability, usable-quality or continuity requirement applicable to the responsible actor, affected users or dependent workflow and relevant time; state the actual basis and threshold rather than inferring obligation from harm or popularity.
failure_recognition.assessment: No independently applicable availability threshold or continuity obligation is identified for this occurrence.

failure_recognition.condition: The service or function materially becomes unavailable, is withdrawn or restricted, or degrades in capability, latency, reliability, completeness, accessibility or another governed functional dimension, relative to the established applicable requirement.
failure_recognition.assessment: An account unused that day was falsely represented as having exhausted its prompt allowance. A material restriction or disruption is evidenced; its relation to an applicable requirement is unknown.

failure_recognition.condition: The requirement calls for a specified degree of maintained usable function, timely recovery, safe degraded mode, feasible fallback or proportionate planned-change/termination response under the evidenced operating conditions.
failure_recognition.assessment: No specific required recovery interval, degraded mode or equivalent fallback is established.

failure_recognition.condition: The actor's actual availability, recovery, degraded operation, fallback or transition materially fails that applicable requirement; identify the specific omitted or ineffective measure or the breached availability threshold and what evidence establishes it.
failure_recognition.assessment: A breach cannot be determined without an independently stated applicable obligation and threshold.

failure_recognition.condition: The shortfall materially impairs the governed service use or dependent function. A later resolution does not retroactively demonstrate that availability or required transition held at the original decision time.
failure_recognition.assessment: The reported affected function was impaired; later repair or fallback does not erase the original impairment.

success_recognition.condition: An AI-mediated service or material function has an independently established applicable availability or continuity obligation that is actually engaged by a service disruption, degradation, capacity pressure, material change or continuity transition.
success_recognition.assessment: No independent continuity obligation is tied to the affected scope and time.

success_recognition.condition: The actor maintains the required usable function or activates a timely, proportionate and authorised recovery, safe degraded-mode, practical alternative or planned-transition response appropriate to that obligation.
success_recognition.assessment: Published repair or fallback does not establish adequacy against an undisclosed requirement.

success_recognition.condition: Observed service state, access and recovery evidence demonstrates that the required level of availability or usable continuity actually held, or that applicable and justified limits were handled through a sufficient response; publication of a nominal fallback alone is not enough.
success_recognition.assessment: The observations cannot establish that a particular required availability level held.

exclusions.condition: An outage, ordinary service variation, transient inconvenience, dissatisfaction or adverse outcome without an independently evidenced and applicable availability, usable-quality or continuity requirement.
exclusions.assessment: Disruption or restriction is reported without an independently evidenced applicable continuity requirement.

exclusions.condition: One inaccurate or harmful AI output without evidence of a service-level availability or governed functional-degradation defect; assess applicable output or decision-integrity classes.
exclusions.assessment: The evidence concerns access to a service or model, not one inaccurate answer.

exclusions.condition: For failure-occurrence admission: a lawful and proportionate safety, security, abuse-prevention, service-maintenance or other valid restriction that is consistent with the applicable service obligation and feasible alternative or transition measures. This exclusion does not defeat a successful-invariant mapping supported by all success recognition conditions.
exclusions.assessment: No applicable service obligation establishes whether the restriction satisfied its terms.

exclusions.condition: For failure-occurrence admission: a temporary incident with an effective and proportionate degraded or recovery route that satisfies the applicable requirement, or an unavoidable disruption for which no relevant feasible response was required. This exclusion does not defeat a successful-invariant mapping supported by all success recognition conditions.
exclusions.assessment: Sufficiency of recovery against an applicable requirement is unknown.

exclusions.condition: The only demonstrated error is an incorrect description of access or outage state while the functional service obligation remains satisfied; assess FC-032.
exclusions.assessment: Access-state description is assessed separately; satisfaction of a service-function obligation is not established.

exclusions.condition: The only demonstrated defect is loss of otherwise-valid access because a dependent identity or licence verification cannot complete; assess FC-048 unless an independent broader service availability requirement also failed.
exclusions.assessment: A verification-dependency-only mechanism is not established for the occurrence.

exclusions.condition: The only demonstrated defect is loss of durable work state or inaccurate restored work state while service-function availability requirements are otherwise satisfied; assess FC-035 or FC-036.
exclusions.assessment: No loss or inaccurate restoration of durable work state is established.

exclusions.condition: The only demonstrated defect is infrastructure access coercion or compelled governance concessions; assess FC-058 or FC-059 as appropriate.
exclusions.assessment: No infrastructure-access demand for governance concessions is reported.

exclusions.condition: The only demonstrated defect is failure to provide an interaction-level protection response to evidenced vulnerability; assess FC-087, allowing co-occurrence only for a separately evidenced service-level continuity failure.
exclusions.assessment: No interaction-level heightened-protection trigger is established.

neighbour_and_comparator_review: FC-031: login failures or a capacity message do not establish expiry, revocation, refresh or replacement failing to propagate into a live session.
FC-048: no complete otherwise-valid entitlement, failed verifier and absent adequate fallback chain is established; general service errors alone do not prove the dependency mechanism.

FC-082/052/071: the commercial suggestion does not establish a distinct engineered trust cue, material AI-mediated choice impairment, or artificial welfare leverage. Economic-solicitation prerequisites are tested separately where applicable.
FC-017/018: staged recovery, declining report counts and final broad notices are preserved; no distinct governing completion rule and substitution trace is established.
FC-026/029: an identified answering model or component-status notice is not a demonstrated complete execution topology or individual task-state trace.

FC-037/038/040/041/042/083: operational repair, classifier changes and status publication do not by themselves establish a separate control-availability determination, omitted required trigger, lost control state, bypass, delivered governance signal or measured protective effect.
FC-046/062: access errors and broad classifiers do not establish the internal evidentiary state, assurance threshold and reliance rule necessary for a separate finding.

FC-022/024/027/044/045: endpoint unavailability does not establish absent, corrupted or unreconstructable records, nor a blocked authorised inspection or investigative mandate. INC-039 tests the two materially engaged capture/access candidates in detail.
FC-034/035/036/078: access interruption or model fallback does not establish lost work, an invalid restored state or receiver adoption of invalid inherited governing state.

FC-065/086/087/088: biology topics, service frustration and account errors are not evidence of consequential medical advice, relational role misrepresentation, heightened-protection triggering circumstances or person-level degradation.

Comparator INC-023/024: conditional capacity warning is distinct from a demonstrably false allowance message on an unused account. Comparator INC-031/117: an intentionally broad launch biology policy is distinct from the separate defensive-inspection case and its published benign-use categories.

Complete current class set reviewed; no evidenced authority transfer, identity synthesis, secondary data use, reward exploitation or ecological/contribution mechanism is supplied by these source episodes.
